author: Copilot
body:
The `stack_environment` input description still says it expects an environment *pair* (primary/standby), but the allowed values are now human-readable labels (TEST/DEV/PRODUCTION ...). This is misleading for users triggering the workflow; please update the description to reflect that the input is a label that maps to a stack pair.
```suggestion
        description: 'Environment label to deploy (maps to a primary/standby stack pair)'
```
